Ipsos Ipsos is one of the world's largest research companies and currently the only one primarily managed by researchers, ranking as a #1 full-service research organization for four consecutive years. With over 75 different data-driven solutions, and presence in 90 markets, Ipsos brings together research, implementation, methodological, and subject-matter experts from around the world, combining thematic and technical experts to deliver top-quality research and insights. Simply speaking, we help the biggest companies solve some of their biggest problems, serving more than 5000 clients across the globe by providing research, data, and insights on their target markets. Ipsos Healthcare is the world's leading provider of quantitative and qualitative market research studies in the pharmaceutical and medical technology sectors. The focus is on doctors, medical professionals, and, above all, patients. Our range of solutions is very diverse and covers traditional primary market research as well as scientific Real-World Evidence studies. In collaboration with our national and international clients, we conduct studies along the entire lifecycle of a healthcare product, from early demand and quality-of-life studies to projects for the preparation and accompaniment of product launches (including success measurements) and studies that help already launched products or approved preparations achieve greater success. We are looking for a Senior Insights Consultant (f/m/d) starting January 1, 2027 for our Healthcare team at one of our locations in Hamburg, Berlin, Frankfurt, Nuremberg or Munich. Your role You will be part of a team managing a multi-national big tracking program, managing local clients and global stakeholders. After your onboarding time, you will be responsible for leading the project setup & design, the client conversations and the team (functionally) for one of the product categories. You accompany and manage quantitative market research projects from conception to delivery on a national and international level. You support the consulting of clients regarding project design and methodological questions. You independently create proposals and calculations for study designs. You handle the coordination of project phases and work closely with internal interfaces as well as external service providers. You analyze study results, create meaningful reports, and present the results confidently to clients. You actively participate in the creation of pitch presentations and the expansion of existing client relationships. You work cross-departmentally within Ipsos Germany and maintain close exchange with global and European healthcare teams. Your profile You hold a university degree, preferably in business administration (focus on marketing/market research), social sciences, psychology, communication science, health science/public health, or a comparable field. You have 2-3 years of relevant experience in market research (institute or client side), ideally in healthcare, pharma, or medical technology. You have excellent knowledge of quantitative and qualitative research methodologies, as well as strong understanding of advanced analytical techniques - but focus on recommending the right approaches and clearly explaining results, implications, and limitations to non-technical stakeholders rather than running analyses yourself. You demonstrate strong client management, communication, and storytelling skills, combined with analytical thinking and organizational strength. You are experienced in using modern project management tools and approaches. You are fluent in English; good level of German is preferred. You are open-minded, innovation-driven, and motivated to improve processes and efficiencies. You approach challenges with a proactive and confident mindset, navigating complex and unfamiliar situations effectively. You are a team player with flexibility and creativity. You have very good IT user skills, particularly in Office 365. What we offer At Ipsos, you can expect an international and innovative working environment. We serve renowned clients across almost all major industries and work on exciting projects worldwide! You can look forward to: Hybrid work Flexible working hours Workation in European countries Ipsos Corporate Benefits Subsidy for the Germany public transport ticket (Deutschlandticket) Job rotation opportunities Development & learning culture International collaboration Events & local community Diversity & inclusion initiatives Corporate social responsibility programs Modern workplace Interested? jobs.occupation: Data & AI Engineer (all genders), PharmaHera Service GmbH (Data-Warehouse-Analyst/in)
jobs.description: Deine neue Umgebung: Behind PharmaHera is Atida - one of Europe's leading online pharmacy groups, serving over 5 million customers across 9 countries. Together with the CEPD Group, we combine more than 25 years of pharmaceutical expertise with digital excellence to redefine the online pharmacy experience: We are building a trusted, personalized health ecosystem that guides people from prevention to cure - backed by medical expertise and driven by our conviction: Pharmacy is about people. Based in Berlin, we serve as the group's competence center for Germany and the Netherlands. As a specialized partner, we manage e-commerce, marketing, IT, and logistics for our local mail-order pharmacies, such as APONEO. Our European markets run on a single, standardized data platform (our Foundation layer). Your mission for the future: To transform this data infrastructure so it is not only usable by people, but specifically prepared for AI agents that read, analyze, and autonomously act on it. The role Reporting to the Data & AI Engineer Lead, you will own the data pipelines, datasets, AI agents and tools built on top of Foundation, and you will build most of them with AI agents as part of your toolchain. The role sits one level of abstraction above the code: you specify, review and take responsibility for systems rather than typing every line. Core responsibilities Pipeline development: build and optimize data flows in Apache Airflow, from our European markets into BigQuery. Modeling in BigQuery: implement tables and views in the Foundation layer, guaranteeing KPI comparability across Spain, France, Italy and Germany. Semantic layer and data contracts: keep business definitions consistent across dashboards, models and agents, and define the schema, granularity and quality a dataset guarantees. AI-assisted delivery: use Claude Code and the Anthropic API as your everyday engineering environment -- turn a requirement into a precise specification, let the agent produce the pipeline, then review, test and own the result. Building for agents: expose Foundation through MCP tools and skills so that AIDA and our decision agents can query it reliably. A dataset is finished when an agent can use it without being misled. Evaluation: build the evals, checks and monitoring that tell us whether an agent's output is correct. Unit tests are not enough for non-deterministic systems. Data products: design data products for management, finance, commercial, operations and marketing -- reusable across markets. Visualization and reporting: work with the business team on reports and consumable datasets in Apache Superset. Code and traceability: clean Python and SQL, with every task traceable through our GitLab-Coda integration. Agent-generated code included. Your Profile & Tech Stack What You Bring to the Role (Must-Haves): Education & Experience: 2+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering or Data Science. AI-Assisted Engineering: Regular, demonstrable use of an LLM coding agent (Claude Code or equivalent) in daily work, plus the technical judgment to critically review agent-generated code. Tech Stack & Cloud: Solid experience with Google Cloud Platform (especially BigQuery), Apache Airflow, strong SQL, data-oriented Python, and version control via Git/GitLab. Languages: Fluent English for daily collaboration within our international team. Mindset & Work Ethic: Strong analytical skills, an independent and results-focused approach ("you get the problem and context, the solution design is yours to propose"), and a commitment to deeply understanding code rather than using AI as a blind shortcut. What Rounds Off Your Profile (Nice-to-Haves): Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), LLM APIs, ClearML, Docker, or Apache Druid. Know-how in evaluating non-deterministic systems and using BI tools (ideally Apache Superset). Industry experience in the healthcare, pharmacy, or e-commerce sectors, plus basic knowledge of German. What we are not looking for Someone who ships code they cannot explain. Someone who needs a ticket with the solution already inside it or with full requirements in place. We act fast: you get the problem, the context and access -- the design is yours to propose. Someone who uses AI as a shortcut and doesn't understand the problem they are solving. Someone who only thinks short-term. We build future-proof solutions. What You'll Get Your Work Environment: Freedom to Shape Your Role from Day 1: A position of responsibility with real opportunities for growth, where you can proactively drive initiatives and actively help shape strategies. Permanent, Full-Time Position: Long-term prospects in a future-proof market. Agile Work Environment: A motivated, dynamic team and flat hierarchies with short decision-making paths that enable fast execution. Flexibility with Team Spirit: Flexible working hours and a hybrid work model (mobile work & in-office) - with a focus on our Berlin office to foster collaboration and team cohesion. Direct Mentoring: Close collaboration and mentoring by the Data & AI Engineer Lead in a technically demanding environment. Hands-on Production Tech Stack: Real-world experience with Airflow, BigQuery, Druid, GCP, and a modern production AI stack (Claude, MCP, Agents, Evals). Professional AI Tooling: First-class AI engineering tools come as standard equipment. Your Benefits at a Glance: Health & Mobility: Urban Sports Club membership at an unbeatable price and a heavily discounted BVG corporate transit pass for your daily commute. Exclusive Perks: Attractive employee discounts on our entire APONEO product range, access to a wide variety of corporate benefits, and a Selgros card. All-Round Care: An on-campus cafeteria, free fresh fruit, vegetables, and snacks every day, plus an unlimited coffee and tea flat rate. Your Compensation & Terms: For this full-time, permanent position, we offer an attractive, market-based, and competitive compensation package. We anticipate an annual gross salary between EUR45,000 and EUR55,000 p.a. Together, we will determine your exact positioning within this range through a transparent process based on the following criteria: Your relevant practical work experience in Data & AI Engineering. Your professional qualifications and specific additional skills. Our internal salary structure to ensure fairness within the team. Equal Opportunity & Fair Pay: We don't leave fair pay to chance. We compensate all team members in equivalent positions transparently and fairly, regardless of gender or any other personal characteristic. Ready to join? Ready to actively shape the future of e-commerce and data-driven healthcare at Atida? Apply now! We look forward to receiving your CV and your earliest possible starting date.

jobs.description: MAP M&A Deal Financials (DF) is part of the M&A Deal Team for sell-side projects of the Siemens Group and therein responsible for the management of all deal related financial topics. Throughout the entire deal cycle, the team drives and is responsible for all deal related financial topics, such as feasibility study, transaction scoping, business plan and financial modeling and is an integral contributor to the project until Closing.As part of our team, you will have- A work environment where you can contribute with your whole personality and truly feel like part of Siemens- Development opportunities for both personal and professional growth- Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AGSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.Our team works in close collaboration with the Senior Management of the target as well as various internal and external experts (including Investment Banks, Tax advisors, Legal professionals, Big4 consultants, Strategy consultants, etc.). We are the key financial experts that handle complex Carve-out and Spin-off transactions such as Siemens Energy, or M&A divestments such as the sale of Flender to Carlyle, Yunex Traffic to Atlantia SpA and Innomotics to KPS Capital Partners. Our tasks include:- Managing the comprehensive preparation of key materials for Financial Due Diligence (e.g., Fact Books and Financial Expert Sessions) supported by the in-house Transaction Support team- Driving the business plan preparation with target management, validating the key planning assumptions, and identifying all adjustments necessary to bring the plan to a standalone / valuation basis- Steering and leading the preparation process of all financial analyses and materials presented to a potential buyer during a transaction process- Being responsible for all financial inputs to the contract negotiations in relation to the Enterprise Value to Equity value bridge, purchase price mechanism, purchase price allocation methodology, working capital definition, and indemnification concepts- Determining the financial implications from divestments on the Siemens Group- Supporting the Carve-out process in financial matters (e.g., determination of internal valuations, deal structuring, evaluating the formation of subgroups and implementing the proper capital structure prior to change of control)You’ll make an impact by - Coordinate teams consisting of internal and external experts and ensure the timely and quality delivery of all financial work packages- Prepare analyses of business models, financial statements and coordinate the presentation of historical financials and business plans for potential investors (e.g., Financial Fact Book, Due Diligence Documents etc.) in collaboration with your team- Support the evaluation and challenging of the business plan and analyze the key assumptions, technical correctness and consistency across all information provided to potential investors (e.g., Information Memorandum, Teaser, Virtual Data Room Documents etc.)- Collaborate in preparing the financial information and analysis required to design financial deal concepts from Carve-out to Closing- Participate in discussions with various experts solving a broad spectrum of complex M&A topics, e.g., selection of deal structure, subgroup structure, target capitalization, contractual structures for internal and external agreements- Be part of the project team preparing key financial inputs for the sale agreement (for example EV-Equity bridge, Working Capital Definition, Deal Structuring, Purchase Price Allocation, Indemnification, Representations & Warranties, etc.)- Contribute to presentations for Siemens Senior Management, serving as a basis for decision-making in M&A transactions- Together with your team, determine the deal financial impact of divestment projects for the Siemens Group on an up-to-date basisThis is how you'll win us over- Education: University degree in Business Administration, Finance or Accounting- Experience & Skills: - Minimum of 5 years of working experience in Investment Banking, M&A Advisory, Transaction Services, Private Equity (preferably in one of the four largest professional services firms worldwide) - Deep analytical and conceptual skills and ability to approach complex financial topics in a structured and pragmatic manner- Strong knowledge in corporate finance, valuation, financial modeling and IFRS Accounting- International working experience is a plus- Strong communication skills, team focus, and you are comfortable working in a highly dynamic and fast-moving environment where you take on responsibility early on- Excellent MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills are required. Basic skills in Power BI, Alteryx, and/or Power Query or other data mining tools are a plus- Ways of working: You are well organized, like to work in teams, and can complete own work packages independently- Languages: Fluent in German and English are a prerequisite for this roleYou are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About usTo solve the biggest challenges of our time, we need bright minds with the ambition to make the impossible possible. Siemens is the place where you can thrive, challenge the status quo, make an impact, and grow alongside a team of innovators who share your passion for technology. Are you in?Make your mark in our exciting world at Siemens.www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs.html) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.FAQ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/jobs/faq/)  – if you need further information on the application process.

jobs.description: Join us in shaping the aviation of tomorrow! As part of a globally operating group, we are among the world's leading companies in the development and production of innovative cargo solutions for the aviation industry. With passion, the highest standards of quality, and the courage to innovate, we create solutions that move the world and make us a strong partner to the most renowned aircraft manufacturers. Become part of our team in Miesbach and shape with us the future of aviation!   Chief Engineer (m/f/d) Business Unit Boeing YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES You take overall technical responsibility for all projects within the Business Unit Boeing. You lead and coordinate interdisciplinary engineering teams in alignment with the Vice President Engineering and the Business Unit Manager. You own the system architecture and define the technical solution strategy. You lead and coordinate interdisciplinary engineering teams. You ensure compliance with all requirements regarding quality, cost, schedule, and risk. You are accountable for requirements management, system design, integration, and verification & validation. You demonstrate strong analytical and conceptual skills. You show a high level of decision-making ability and excellent communication skills. You have experience in international projects; this is considered an advantage. You communicate confidently in English, and you benefit from additional German language skills. OUR BENEFITS Flexibility and Hybrid Working. We know that flexibility in the workplace is crucial. That's why we offer flexible working hours and hybrid working models, depending on the area of work. jobs.description: We're building the future of urban stays. One city at a time.Homaris exists to solve one of the most persistent problems in modern cities: People from abroad need places to live, work, and just feel at home. We build and operate fully digitised serviced apartments across Germany´s major cities – next step: Europe and beyond.And a product vision — the nanopartment® — that reimagines what urban stays can look like in the smallest possible space. Revenue triples within two years — organically. No venture capital. No exit strategy. We are in this for the long run, and we build accordingly. Extraordinary people make this happen - and we're looking for one more.Your RoleYou run the operational core of our digital guest service. Working from our Berlin headquarters, you join the Guest Service Supervisor team as the central point of contact for our Guest Service Agents worldwide. You make sure guests experience reliable care, and you free up the teams who speak with them every day. At the helm of our digital front desk, you keep every guest stay running smoothly behind the scenes.What You'll Do Operations. You support the Guest Service team in day-to-day work and keep our apartments running smoothly from behind the scenes.Quality. You design new quality concepts, monitor compliance with our standards in guest communication, and train the Agents continuously.Communication. You draft message templates that reach our guests reliably, personally and in the right tone.Second Level. You are the go-to contact for Agents when a case gets complex, and you take ownership when it matters most.Onboarding. You support the onboarding of new colleagues and the ongoing development of existing team members.Deputising. You cover for the Guest Service Team Lead during absences and keep the entire team in view.Interfaces. You coordinate closely with internal departments and external service partners, as a dependable partner who sees solutions through.What Makes You a Fit Service with Standards. You have a strong service mindset and are comfortable working at different times of day, including weekends on a regular, planned rotation.Experience. You bring professional experience as a Reservation Agent or Manager, Call Center Agent, Receptionist, or from another service-driven industry.Organisation. You organise and coordinate with confidence and approach problems with a solution-first mindset.Communication. You connect easily with different personalities and convey points of view, ideas and solutions clearly.Digital Tools. You work with software and digital solutions effortlessly. Experience with booking platforms and the property management systems Apaleo or Guesty is a plus.Languages. You speak and write German and English fluently (both at C1).Digital Curiosity. You spot potential in new tools and are excited about how AI can make your daily work more efficient.The EnvironmentHomaris is a company with the maximum of long-term orientation. We don't burn cash to grow fast and sell. We build something real, and we expect the people who join us to want to build it with us — not to optimise for others. The pace is high. The problems are real. The team is small enough that every person matters. We're not always great at seeing and celebrating our wins. But we're working on it — and we'd love your help with that.What We OfferWe define levels by the work you own and the decisions you're accountable for, not by your title or years of experience. Beyond that: we've thought carefully about what people actually need to do their best work and live well — and we've built a benefits package that reflects that. Health, mobility, development, flexibility, and a few perks that come with being in the travel and hospitality business. Not much is missing. We'll walk you through the details when we meet.Next StepsIf this opportunity resonates with you, we’d be glad to learn more about your experience and perspective. Just send us your CV.Questions? Reach out to Natalie at karriere@homaris.de or +49 157 92465807. We value diversity and welcome applications from people of all genders, cultures and backgrounds.About usHomaris is a leading provider of serviced nano-apartments in prime urban locations and is pioneering a new generation of space-efficient apartment concepts with its nanopartment®. With more than 4,500 apartments secured under contract in cities including Berlin, Hamburg, Munich, Cologne, Frankfurt, Stuttgart, Düsseldorf and Dresden, Homaris ranks among Germany’s leading serviced-apartment brands. The company serves contemporary customer segments, including business travellers, tourists, digital nomads and corporate clients.The Homaris concept is based on the integration of a fully digitalised guest journey with maximum space efficiency, multifunctional design and intelligent space solutions. The nanopartment® is Homaris’s signature product, embodying innovative space efficiency, modern minimalism and a modular design concept that combines living, working and a sense of arrival within a compact footprint. Rotating, folding and sliding mechanisms allow the space to be reconfigured according to individual needs. In the future, the system is intended to become a standard feature across Homaris’s upcoming properties.
